    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)

    # The non-background rectangle has a colored border around a differently
    # colored interior. Use the border width to extend the interior color.
    border = grid[r0][c0]

    thickness = 0
